summary: This is an 8-K filing by Tango Therapeutics reporting an underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The offering comprises 18,166,667 firm shares at $30.00/share and pre-funded warrants at $29.999 each, exercisable at $0.001. The underwriters have a 30-day option for an additional 3,000,009 shares. The company is the issuer selling its own equity securities in a capital-raising transaction. The offering is expected to close on June 11, 2026. This is a routine equity financing, not a special-situation event.
